title: Fix Undo functionality and improve over-by-over reporting on Live Scoring screen

requirements.summary: Add visible and functional 'Undo last ball' button on Live Scoring page that removes the most recently recorded ball and updates all scoreboard values
acceptanceCriteria: An 'Undo last ball' button is visible on the Live Scoring screen at all times during active scoring
Clicking 'Undo' removes the last recorded ball from the innings ball history
All scoreboard values (total runs, wickets, overs, balls, striker runs, non-striker runs, bowler stats) update immediately after undo
Undo works correctly for both local-only matches and backend-synced matches
The button is disabled when there are no balls to undo (innings ball history is empty)
User sees a success toast message after successfully undoing a ball

file_operations.description: Add an undoLastBall function that removes the most recent ball from the current innings ball history in local storage, then saves the updated match state. The function should return the updated match or null if no balls exist to undo. Handle edge cases where innings or balls array is empty.

Add a new useUndoLastBall mutation hook that calls localMatchStore.undoLastBall for local matches. For backend-synced matches, the mutation should update local storage first (optimistic update), then invalidate match queries to trigger a refetch. Include error handling and success toast notifications.

Add an 'Undo Last Ball' button to the live scoring UI positioned near the scoring controls. Wire it to the useUndoLastBall mutation hook. Disable the button when there are no balls in the current innings (check currentInnings.balls.length === 0). Show loading state during mutation. Ensure the button is visible and accessible on mobile screens.

requirements.summary: Fix Live Scoring page state reload behavior so that navigating away and returning preserves striker, non-striker, and bowler selections without requiring re-selection
acceptanceCriteria: After navigating from Live Scoring to Match Stats and back, the striker and non-striker remain selected without requiring re-selection
The bowler selection is also preserved across navigation
All scoring controls (run buttons, wicket, extras) remain enabled and functional after returning
The ball history and scoreboard values remain accurate after navigation round-trip
No 'Please select striker and non-striker' blocking message appears when returning to a match that already has batters selected

file_operations.description: Review and fix the state management for striker, non-striker, and bowler selections. Currently, these selections are stored in local component state and reset on unmount. Modify the logic to persist these selections in the match data structure (either in a temporary field or derive them from the most recent ball). When the component mounts, check if the innings has balls and automatically restore the last known striker, non-striker, and bowler from the most recent ball instead of clearing selections. Remove or adjust any useEffect hooks that unnecessarily reset these values on mount. Ensure the 'Please select striker and non-striker' guard only appears when the innings truly has no batters selected (empty balls array and no stored selections).

requirements.summary: Replace the existing 'Last Over' summary with a comprehensive over-by-over breakdown displaying runs scored in each individual completed over throughout the current innings
acceptanceCriteria: The Live Scoring screen displays a list/grid showing runs scored in each completed over (Over 1: X runs, Over 2: Y runs, etc.)
The breakdown updates immediately after each over is completed (6 legal deliveries)
The display shows overs in chronological order (1st, 2nd, 3rd...) so the scorer can see scoring progression
The component uses the existing computeOverByOverBreakdown utility to compute over data
The over-by-over breakdown is visible and scrollable on mobile screens without layout overflow

file_operations.description: Replace the existing 'Last Over' display with the OverByOverBreakdown component. Import and render the OverByOverBreakdown component from frontend/src/components/live/OverByOverBreakdown.tsx, passing it the current innings data. Position it in a scrollable section that works on mobile devices. Remove or comment out any references to the old 'Last Over' summary UI.

Review the existing OverByOverBreakdown component implementation. Ensure it correctly uses the computeOverByOverBreakdown utility from frontend/src/utils/overByOverBreakdown.ts to generate the over-by-over data. Verify the component displays overs in chronological order (1st, 2nd, 3rd, etc.) with runs per over. Ensure the component has proper mobile-friendly styling with overflow scrolling if needed. Add appropriate loading/empty states if no completed overs exist yet.
